data.description: A wood golem is immune to any spell or spell-like ability that allows spell resistance, with the exception of spells and spell-like abilities that have the Fire descriptor, which affect it normally. In addition, certain spells and effects function differently against the creature, as noted below. * Warp wood or wood shape slows a wood golem (as the slow spell) for 2d6 rounds (no save). * Repel wood drives the golem back 60 feet and deals 2d12 points of damage to it (no save). * A magical attack that deals cold damage breaks any slow effect on the golem and heals 1 point of damage for every 3 points of damage the attack would otherwise deal. If the amount of healing would cause the golem to exceed its full normal hit points, it gains any excess as temporary hit points. A wood golem gets no saving throw against attacks that deal cold damage.
data.name: Immunity to Magic
